summary: This table presents an overview of client metrics for the quarters ending September 30, 2025, June 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024. It includes the number of active clients, clients added during the period, and the count of clients categorized by revenue thresholds (1 million, 10 million, 50 million, and 100 million dollars). Additionally, it details client contributions to revenues, highlighting the percentage contributions from the top 5, 10, and 25 clients, as well as the Days Sales Outstanding metric. Notably, the number of active clients increased from 1,870 in September 2024 to 1,896 in September 2025, while the Days Sales Outstanding decreased slightly from 73 to 71 over the same period.
